description: Makes a link for the person in this chat to open in their own browser, signed in to Cosend, to do one set-up step only they can do there, and returns its url. It works for 30 minutes and only for them, and carries no password or key. kind connect_number connects a WhatsApp number; reconnect_number needs connection_id and runs Meta’s flow again for that number; connect_integrations needs connectors (each integration by its Cosend key, as list_connectors gives them) and completes when every one has an account, and with account_id (and that account’s one connector) the person types a new key for an account that already exists; pick_google_file needs account_id, a Google account, and opens Google’s file picker for it so the person can choose spreadsheets Cosend may open; upgrade needs plan, the plan to buy; payment_method adds a card. The person does the step themselves on the page: they connect the number in Meta’s window, sign in to the integration or type its key, choose files in Google’s picker, pay in Stripe’s Checkout, or add the card. It cannot be done for them. A new link of the same kind cancels the workspace’s open one, whoever made it.

account_id.description: The connected Google account whose file picker opens, by its connector account id. The person chooses the spreadsheets Cosend may open; the link completes when the picker was opened.

connection_id.description: The WhatsApp number to reconnect, by its connection id. The person runs Meta’s flow again for it, and the link completes when that number is connected.

connectors.description: The integrations the person signs in to, by key from GET /v1/connectors. The link completes when every one of them has an account.

plan.description: The plan to buy, by code from GET /v1/billing/plans. Only for a workspace with no paid subscription, and only to a higher plan.

name: create_setup_link
title: Make a set-up link
